text:
Ava: Quick design pass on the Playground schema editor + function defs + run history. Pushed a small Figma update: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/playground-schema-v3 — would love quick eyes on copy and a11y before we ship to staging.

Ravi: looked through it — nice. Two quick notes: run history rows feel dense; hard to scan which run used which function variant. Maybe show a condensed summary line with "fn name · model · duration" and expand for inputs/outputs. :eyes:

Maya: agree with Ravi. For accessibility, the expand/collapse needs proper aria-expanded + keyboard support. Also the function parameter labels should be programmatically associated with inputs (label for/id).

Sam: from infra POV we also need to show validation errors inline when users paste a function definition. Right now the mock highlights field but there's no copy for the error state. Suggest: "Invalid schema: missing type for param 'userId'" with a "Fix automatically" action.

Ava: good call — proposed microcopy for that state: "Schema invalid — the `type` field is required for each parameter. Click \"Suggest fix\" to auto-fill common types." Thoughts? Also thinking: change CTA "Add parameter" to "Add parameter (optional)" when param isn't required to reduce confusion.

Joan: love the auto-suggest language. For the CTA I prefer shorter labels — what about "Add param" and show a tooltip that says "Click to add a new parameter (optional by default)". Also we should avoid jargon like "schema" in the primary UI; many users say "function signature" feels friendlier in the Playground.

Ava: ok — let's iterate: primary term = "Function signature" in header, secondary help text can say "schema/json for tool-calling". I updated the Figma.

Ravi: run-history UX: when collapsed, show a 1-line timestamp + brief result (success/error) + truncated output preview (first 60 chars) — clicking expands to full output and a copy button. We should also surface which function version + quantization/endpoint used.

Maya: tiny a11y nit — color contrast for the success/error pills is low on the light theme (green on light gray). Need AA contrast. Also focus ring for the copy button should be visible (not just outline: none).

Sam: backend note: we can attach the function variant metadata as a small JSON blob to each run entry. That lets the UI render version badges without extra calls. Will coordinate with API.

Ava: sample suggestion for a function def preview (for copy + validation):
```json
{
  "name": "get_user_profile",
  "params": [
    {"name": "user_id", "type": "string", "required": true},
    {"name": "include_metadata", "type": "boolean", "required": false}
  ],
  "return": {"type": "object"}
}
```

Ava: copy tweak for the schema editor header: "Function signature (used for tool-calling)" — short, accessible. Change run-history header from "Runs" to "Execution history" — clearer for non-devs.

Joan: +1 on "Execution history". For microcopy in run detail, replace "stdout" with "Tool output" and "stderr" with "Tool error" — friendlier language.

Maya: accessibility checklist to verify before PR: 1) keyboard expand/collapse 2) aria-labels on copy buttons 3) label associations for params 4) color contrast AA 5) focus order test with screen reader. Happy to run a quick pass.

Ravi: can we add a small visual affordance in run-history for when a run used cached KV prefix? Maybe a lightning bolt icon + tooltip "served from cache" to explain low-latency runs.

Ava: nice — I'll add a small icon. Final ask: please leave short reactions in this thread if you can review the Figma states I linked. If no major objections I'll merge the copy + a11y notes into the PR tomorrow and tag staging deploy.

deploy-bot: Staging deploy scheduled for 2026-04-03 02:00 UTC with playground/ui v3.4.1 — includes schema editor copy updates (Ava) and run-history layout changes (Ravi).

Sam: noted. I'll wire up the validation errors endpoint and attach the variant blob. ETA EOD tomorrow.

Maya: I'll run the a11y checklist on the staging build once deployed.

Joan: will post final microcopy suggestions as comments in Figma.

Ava: thanks everyone :raised_hands: — will follow up with a short PR that includes the copy strings + aria attributes we discussed.
